mapper.sql: AND A.APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND A.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUERY_REQUEST Q WHERE Q.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID AND Q.REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND Q.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' ) AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND ( ( A.APPROVAL_ORDER = 1 AND A.APPROVAL_TYPE = 'DIRECTOR' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUERY_REQUEST Q JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE Q.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID AND Q.DRAFTER_ID <> #{approverId} AND Q.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID AND P.POSITION_CODE = 'DIRECTOR' ) ) OR ( A.APPROVAL_ORDER = 2 AND A.APPROVAL_TYPE = 'INTERMEDIATE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'DB_APPROVER' ) ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, DU.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, R.SUBMITTED_AT, A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE FROM APPROVAL A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID JOIN USERS DU ON DU.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY R.SUBMITTED_AT, R.REQUEST_ID

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, R.DETAIL_CONTENT, R.IS_URGENT, R.DESIRED_DATE, DU.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.SUBMITTED_AT FROM QUERY_REQUEST R JOIN USERS DU ON DU.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APPROVAL A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID
)

SELECT I.QUERY_ID, I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_TITLE, I.SQL_TEXT, I.AUTHORING_TYPE, I.VALIDATION_STATUS, I.ITEM_CLASS FROM QUERY_ITEM I WHERE I.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APPROVAL A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = I.REQUEST_ID
) ORDER BY I.QUERY_ORDER

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE U.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND P.POSITION_CODE = 'DIRECTOR' ORDER BY U.USER_ID

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'DB_APPROVER' AND U.USER_ID <> #{departmentApproverId} ORDER BY U.USER_NAME, U.USER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPROVAL ( APPROVAL_ID, REQUEST_ID, APPROVER_ID, APPROVAL_ORDER, APPROVAL_TYPE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_APPROVAL.NEXTVAL, #{requestId}, #{approverId}, #{approvalOrder}, #{approvalType}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_ID, DRAFTER_ID, REQUEST_STATUS, APPROVAL_STATUS FROM QUERY_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT A.APPROVAL_ID, A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE FROM APPROVAL A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND A.APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND A.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND ( ( A.APPROVAL_ORDER = 1 AND A.APPROVAL_TYPE = 'DIRECTOR' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUERY_REQUEST Q JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE Q.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID AND Q.DRAFTER_ID <> #{approverId} AND Q.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID AND P.POSITION_CODE = 'DIRECTOR' ) ) OR ( A.APPROVAL_ORDER = 2 AND A.APPROVAL_TYPE = 'INTERMEDIATE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'DB_APPROVER' ) ) ) FOR UPDATE OF A.APPROVAL_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE APPROVAL SET STATUS = 'PENDING' WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND APPROVAL_ORDER = 2 AND APPROVAL_TYPE = 'INTERMEDIATE' AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
UPDATE QUERY_REQUEST SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED', REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
UPDATE APPROVAL SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', COMMENT_TEXT = #{commentText}, DECIDED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE APPROVAL_ID = #{approvalId} AND APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE APPROVAL SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
UPDATE QUERY_REQUEST SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'REJECTED', REQUEST_STATUS = 'REJECTED' WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
